resources.string: An independent monitoring target on your home screen. Tap to check or open settings.
No data yet — wait for a few checks.
Tap a bar to see the check results for that period. Red: outage; orange: no internet or partially reachable; gray: no data. The availability percentage in the summary is based on time.
The profile sets the intervals for screen on, sleep and outages. Picking an interval below switches to a custom one.
Check while the screen is off
The sleep interval depends on the profile. Android may delay alarms; the time of the last check is always shown.
Vibrate when Telegram is partially reachable
Alerts when only MTProto or only the web responds. All outage alerts respect quiet hours and fire at most once every 5 minutes.
Vibrate when the internet connection is lost
Short vibration when the connection is back
Notify about a full Telegram outage
Quiet notice when Telegram is slow (over 1 s)
Notify when the connection is back
Sound for a full Telegram outage
Sound when the connection is back
Sound is off by default. Outage alerts fire at most once every 5 minutes. During quiet hours and in Do Not Disturb mode, events arrive without sound or vibration.

Review this frozen snapshot before opening the system Sharesheet. Addresses, tokens and raw diagnostics are excluded.
Another card is being prepared. Retry when it finishes.
This PNG preview expired. Refresh the preview before sharing.
A public HTTPS response was received. Video playback, account access and AI features have not been tested. Verify the feature in your browser.
The response contains an explicit regional refusal. A second observation on this connection is needed for confirmation. You can compare two connections.

Explicit regional refusal was observed repeatedly on this connection. This concerns the public site; account and feature availability can differ. Compare connections without changing them automatically.
The public request requires sign-in. This does not establish a regional block. Open the service in your browser to check your account.
An anti-bot challenge or CAPTCHA was detected. This does not establish a regional block. Complete the check in your browser; the monitor cannot do it for you.
The server is limiting requests. Wait before trying again. Rate limiting does not establish a regional block.
DNS lookup failed. A later connection, TLS handshake and HTTP response were not confirmed. Check DNS or compare connections; this alone does not establish a regional block.
TLS connection failed. A trustworthy HTTP response was not obtained. Check device time and network interception or compare connections. This alone does not establish a regional block.
The request timed out. No usable public response was measured; the exact failing stage is unknown. A timeout does not establish a regional block. Compare connections.
The network connection failed before a usable HTTP response. The cause is not established. Check internet access or compare connections.
No usable public response was received. The failing network stage was not identified. Check internet access or compare connections.
An HTTP response was received without a recognized availability signal. A generic denial, including HTTP 403 or 451, does not establish a regional block. Inspect the service in your browser.
No fresh public observation is available on this connection. Enable monitoring and the profile, then check again. Older history is not a current diagnosis.
Open YouTube and play a video. A loaded home page alone does not confirm playback. No result is recorded by opening the browser.
Open Gemini, sign in if needed and send a test question. A public page response does not confirm a working conversation. No result is recorded by opening the browser.
Open Notebook, sign in if needed and try the notebook feature you need. The public landing page does not confirm feature access. No result is recorded by opening the browser.
Open Antigravity and test the feature you need with your account. The public website response does not confirm product access. No result is recorded by opening the browser.
Open ChatGPT / dots and test the feature you need with your account. A response or redirect does not confirm access to dots. No result is recorded by opening the browser.
